summary: Lead ruling from DESIGN-SPEC section 8.9: the Schedule Manager status filter keeps its stored values and only its labels change. APR-027 named five of them (Active, Paused, Completed, Failed, Expired); the seven labels need two more, Held (Needs you) and Canceled, which SQR-014 and APR-027 now name as added values, with All as no filter. Answers blind review R-03.
approval_basis: The spec states: "the status trigger (`sched-pick-manager-status`, values unchanged, labels \"Waiting / Paused / Needs you / Done or sent / Didn't send / Skipped / Canceled\")" (section 8.9). The values it keeps unchanged are the concept's filter values all, active, paused, held, completed, failed, expired and canceled; canon had named only five, so held and canceled are added to canon rather than claimed unchanged.
